candidate.answerReason: Dividing 100 hundredths into four equal parts gives 25 hundredths per part, so 1 ÷ 4 = 0.25.

methods.label: Equal sharing in hundredths
methods.explanation: When the whole is divided into 4 equal parts, each part is \(1/4\). To write this as a decimal, split the whole into 100 equal pieces, called hundredths. Each quarter contains \(100\div4=25\) hundredths, so \(1\div4=0.25\).
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 3 whole-number division and explains the hundredths notation required by the displayed question.
